# World Arch Journal

> World Arch Journal (worldarchjournal.com) is an English-language, web-native architecture journal: the practical, evidence-led journal for better existing homes — retrofit, daylight, spatial redesign and low-carbon residential architecture — plus a free materials library with downloadable PBR textures.

World Arch Journal publishes original, fully sourced and illustrated articles on climate-responsive design, facades, courtyards, biophilic design, adaptive reuse, low-carbon materials and digital practice (BIM/AI), written for homeowners, architects and designers. Every article carries named sources, image credits and Article structured data. The site also documents architecture projects and publishes a regular architecture briefing (newsletter).

## Magazine and articles

- [Magazine](https://worldarchjournal.com/magazine/): all editorial articles and topic sections — the full article index, newest first
- [Climate Design](https://worldarchjournal.com/magazine/climate-design/): passive cooling, ventilation, daylight and thermal performance
- [Facades](https://worldarchjournal.com/magazine/facades/): facade systems, rainscreens and bird-safe glazing
- [Courtyard Design](https://worldarchjournal.com/magazine/courtyard-design/): small courtyards, light, privacy and cooling
- [Low-Carbon Materials](https://worldarchjournal.com/magazine/low-carbon-materials/): mass timber, disassembly and material reuse
- [Architectural History & Styles](https://worldarchjournal.com/magazine/architectural-history-styles/): styles and movements, including Brutalism
- [AI & Digital Practice](https://worldarchjournal.com/magazine/ai-digital-practice/): BIM vs CAD and AI in architecture

## Materials library

- [Materials](https://worldarchjournal.com/materials/): interactive material panels — colours and finishes applied live to room visualisations
- [Travertine](https://worldarchjournal.com/materials/stone/natural-stone/travertine/): natural stone panel with free 4K and 16K PBR texture downloads
- [Ceramic and porcelain](https://worldarchjournal.com/materials/stone/ceramic-porcelain/porcelain-stoneware/): porcelain stoneware panel with real-scan PBR texture downloads
- [Fluted wood](https://worldarchjournal.com/materials/wood/fluted-panels/fluted-wood/): fluted wood panel with free texture downloads

## Prompts

- [AI prompt library](https://worldarchjournal.com/prompts/): free and PRO AI prompts for architectural images and videos, each published with reference frames and production settings
- [Empty Land to Finished Building: 10-Second Construction Video Prompt](https://worldarchjournal.com/prompts/land-to-building-construction-prompt/): free prompt — a six-storey residence grows from an empty dirt site to the exact final frame
- [FPV Construction Transformation: Single-Take Video Prompt](https://worldarchjournal.com/prompts/fpv-construction-transformation-prompt/): free prompt — a single-take FPV flight through a site as the building assembles in a chain reaction
- [Miniature Hands Build a Real Building: Video Prompt](https://worldarchjournal.com/prompts/miniature-hands-building-prompt/): free prompt — gloved hands assemble a miniature apartment building to full scale
- [Light-Trace Wireframe to Real Building: Video Prompt](https://worldarchjournal.com/prompts/light-trace-wireframe-building-prompt/): free prompt — light trails trace a house from wireframe to real building at blue hour
- [Luxury Villa Miniature Assembly: Video Prompt](https://worldarchjournal.com/prompts/luxury-villa-miniature-assembly-prompt/): free prompt — a luxury villa assembled in miniature with tweezers, then transformed to full scale
- [From Sketch to Finished Building: Construction Video Prompt](https://worldarchjournal.com/prompts/sketch-to-building-construction-prompt/): free prompt — a hand sketch becomes the real construction of a seven-storey residence
- [Folding Interior Transformation: Living Room Video Prompt](https://worldarchjournal.com/prompts/folding-interior-transformation-prompt/): free prompt — a living room folds into a faceted walnut-and-travertine origami interior
